name: Controlled Implementation
purpose: Execute atomic implementation tasks within strictly assigned file boundaries, adhering to mandatory baseline quality and test-driven cycles to achieve G4.
whenToUse: Writing production source code or unit test suites during Gate G4 execution
Implementing assigned tasks from the active implementation contract
Executing bug fixes, feature extensions, or refactoring within designated file boundaries
Enforcing strict anti-slop rules (no decorative emoji, no fake prod data, no unapproved dependencies)
prerequisites: Gate G3 approved (contracts/architecture/contract.json in APPROVED status)
Assigned task from contracts/implementation/contract.json with defined fileOwnership
Clean git working tree or documented uncommitted changes

inputs.name: taskId
inputs.description: Identifier of the atomic task to implement (e.g., TASK-001)

inputs.name: allowedPaths
inputs.description: Exclusive list of file paths and directories this implementation task is permitted to modify

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Testable conditions and behavior required for task completion

procedure.title: Pre-Flight Boundary and Hygiene Check
procedure.action: Verify git status is clean. Confirm all files to be edited reside strictly within allowedPaths. Reject any instruction requiring edits outside boundary.

procedure.title: Test-Driven Scaffold Construction
procedure.action: Author unit or contract test specifications defining expected inputs, outputs, and edge cases before implementing core logic.

procedure.title: Clean Code Implementation
procedure.action: Implement production logic adhering to Mandatory Baseline Quality (BL-001 through BL-007): zero decorative emoji, zero fake data in prod paths, full error handling, clean typings.

procedure.title: Local Compilation and Lint Verification
procedure.action: Run local formatters, linters, and type-checkers on modified files. Ensure zero syntax errors, type mismatches, or lint violations.

procedure.title: Test Suite Execution and Evidence Capture
procedure.action: Execute unit test runner. Capture stdout, stderr, and exit code. Verify all test assertions pass with 100% success on modified units.

procedure.title: Execution State Update
procedure.action: Update memory/state.json marking taskId as completed in executionState.completedTasks and recording Git diff summary.

expectedOutputs: Production source code and tests strictly confined to allowedPaths
Command execution evidence log demonstrating zero compiler/test errors
Updated memory/state.json reflecting completed task status

potentialFailures: Task requires touching a file outside assigned allowedPaths
Unit tests fail after code changes
Linter fails due to style or unused import violations
failureAndRecovery.recoveryStrategy: If out-of-boundary edit needed, halt task and request architecture contract update. For failing tests, revert breaking change and re-evaluate logic. Run automated formatter (e.g., ruff format, prettier) to resolve style errors.

verificationCriteria: git status shows zero modified files outside assigned allowedPaths
All unit and regression tests pass with exit code 0
Zero anti-slop violations (no decorative emoji, no hardcoded mocks in prod paths)
Implementation contract data tracks task status as VERIFIED
